title: ELVES terms of sale recheck
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. The terms ask buyers to contact the brand first because ELVES has distributors in some countries. They give an ordinary 6-10 week manufacturing and delivery estimate for frames and complete bikes (less for wheelsets and saddles) and say there are quieter times of the year when this estimate is significantly reduced. Claims for errors, transit damage or short delivery must be made in writing within three working days of receipt. Within seven days of receipt, a buyer who finds transport damage or paint flaws should not ride the bike, should keep the whole package and proof of purchase or warranty card, and should contact customer service. These are the brand's general terms, not a delivery promise for a particular order.
